rules.words: the contract loads: every field known, its type and unit, required entries present
points and directions have three components; scalars have one
every quantity has the dimension its field needs
every assumption an entry points to is listed
a posed contract carries no physics cases
a derived or frozen contract carries its interfaces and physics
every physics value is derived by its versioned tool, never typed
only a frozen contract carries a hash, and it matches the content
each stage's gears give its centre distance (profile shift in)
the stages' ratios give the total ratio within its tolerance
two stages' centre distances can reach the input-output offset
power equals torque times speed on the same shaft, within 2 %
every interface has a name of its own
every axis and normal has length 1
every bearing and seat load names a seat that exists
each bearing's outer diameter fits its seat
every seat's centre lies inside the installation space
every bearing type in the contract has a tilt limit
